title: Theory: TheMallWorld is in fact the afterlife
content: There have been several questions regarding the true nature of shared dream spaces such as r/TheMallWorld and r/DreamCartography. The general consensus is that this may as well be some kind of r/ParallelUniverse which is no less 'real' than this one. It could be that the mall world was constructed as a universe or realm perhaps, for dreamers to come. When a person is sleeping, the soul gets temporarily transferred into this other universe. And many people get transported into this same realm, which is why they recall visiting the same places, and occasionally they may meet each other. I have read on one occasion the theory that the dream world is actually where our afterlife is located. We go to this world every time we dream, and when we die we end up there permanently. So wouldn't that suggest that the mall world is in fact the afterlife, our afterlife? There have been stories of alive sleeping people meeting deceased loved ones in mallworld dreams, [such as this one](https://www.reddit.com/r/HighStrangeness/comments/pttxaf/comment/hdz2ifa/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web2x&context=3). So does that mean that deceased people continue 'living' or perhaps existing in the mall world? And how does that relate to religion? Some people, such as maybe Christians, believe in "eternal life". However I have yet to have known at least one person on this planet Earth who is de-facto immortal. If eternal life is indeed true, then there should be multiple such people who are still around since the Middle Ages. But what if "eternal life" actually means a 'life' in the mallworld realm? Can such an existence be even called a 'life'? I mean, that life is strictly defined as existence in this realm only. Could the mallworld realm have been created by God or someone as a place for human souls to reside, when they are dreaming/asleep, and also after their physical death?
